title: Redesign: choose the new world for indian-anpr
question: The roll assigned Highway Signage. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. (Brief: more motion, easier to understand, fun to explore, story first.)

options.label: Highway Signage
options.lineage: Indian expressway guide signs, overhead gantries and yellow-capped kilometre stones
options.thesis: The story is a drive down an Indian expressway: every chapter is a sign you pass, and the ANPR camera sits on the gantry reading the cars below.
materials: a steel gantry with a camera
options.viewport: A full-width green gantry sign reading Indian plates, read live, under it a lane of traffic where each passing car's plate gets boxed and read; exits on the sign are the chapters (Traps 2 km, Rules 4 km, Results 6 km, Live scanner exit); the primary action is the Live scanner exit itself.
options.risk: Can tip into a road-sign costume if motion is decoration rather than the story; signage type must stay readable at body sizes.

raised.raise: The pointer is your headlights: signs and plates glint and become readable where the light falls, and the gantry camera tracks it.
The scroll is the drive: a scrubbable route with named stops, each stop deep-linkable.
Every stop shows one measured before and after (96.3% to 98.8%, 18.8% to 28.1%).
Controls are physical sign parts (flip panels, reflector studs) whose state changes their shape, not just their colour.
Try before commit: type any misread plate on the rules sign and watch the correction happen live.

options.label: Toll Plaza Lane
options.lineage: FASTag toll lanes: booth canopies, boom barriers, lane signals and printed receipts
options.thesis: ANPR's real home: cars roll into the lane, the plate is read, the barrier lifts and a receipt prints each finding.
options.viewport: A toll lane seen head-on: a car pulls up, its plate is read and corrected letter by letter on the booth display, the barrier lifts into the headline; a receipt slip prints the numbers; primary action Open your lane (the live scanner).
options.risk: The most obvious ANPR picture there is; receipts and booths can feel like a parking-app landing page.

options.label: Housie Ticket
options.lineage: loteria card decks, fused with their Indian cousin: Tambola/housie tickets
options.thesis: The caller calls a plate; your ticket of state codes fills in as the reader gets each one right.
options.viewport: A called card flips to show a plate; a ticket grid of state codes below fills a bean when that state is read; the headline is the caller's riddle.
options.case: Holds audience identification: housie is played at every Indian party and is genuinely fun to poke at. Loses product clarity: a recruiter has to translate a game into a pipeline.
options.risk: Fun can bury the numbers; the story's rigour has to survive the game.

options.label: Memphis Showroom
options.thesis: Each chapter a toy-like object in a showroom.
options.viewport: Chunky geometric blocks at play angles.
options.risk: Nothing to do with roads or plates.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful, but no recruiter connects it to number plates.
options.kept: Controls are distinct physical parts whose state changes shape.

options.label: Ink Basin
options.thesis: The page as a liquid surface.
options.viewport: A marbled basin answering the pointer.
options.kept: The page answers the pointer live.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Night to day as the scroll.
options.viewport: A horizon band rising from black.
options.case: Fuses weakly: night-time reading matters for ANPR, but the stage frame does not.
options.kept: A scrubbable timeline of named, linkable states.

options.label: Forge Strike
options.viewport: A glowing bar under the hammer.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no tie to plates or roads.
options.kept: Every step shows a measured before and after.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: The plate develops in the tray.
options.viewport: A print emerging in a tray.
options.case: Declined: it is the darkroom family the redesign is replacing.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark computer-vision landing page, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and demo video side by side, a row of metric cards under it, a Try it live button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other ANPR demo by design.
